name: AkaCE
source_rights_note: Audio and video are cut from 21 Akan movies; the README (non-commercial research only) says nothing about the rights in the films. Needs a rights check (needs-confirmation list); license_class keeps the stated license.

name: ASVP-ESD
source_rights_note: The Zenodo record says the audio comes from movies, TV shows, YouTube channels and emotion-sound websites and licenses the compilation under CC BY 4.0; it names no sources and says nothing about the rights of the original recordings. The project members will decide whether to use it. Needs a rights check (needs-confirmation list); license_class keeps the stated license.

name: BanglaMood
source_rights_note: Clips cut from YouTube videos. The Mendeley record (CC BY 4.0) says nothing about the rights in the videos, and there is no paper. Needs a rights check (needs-confirmation list); license_class keeps the stated license.

name: BAUM-2
source_rights_note: Video clips extracted from movies and TV programmes in several languages (paper abstract); the UCI page offers the database under CC BY 4.0 on request and says nothing about rights in the source programmes. Needs a rights check; license_class keeps the stated license.

name: DFEW
source_rights_note: The terms state that the clips come from the Internet and are not the lab's property; no permission from the owners is documented. Needs a rights check (needs-confirmation list); license_class keeps the stated license.

name: Galgame_Speech_SER
source_rights_note: Voices from commercial Japanese visual novels (derivative of OOPPEENN/Galgame_Dataset). The card forbids commercial use and says commercial use needs authorisation from all providers, i.e. the rights stay with the game makers; no permission is documented. Needs a rights check (needs-confirmation list); license_class keeps the stated license.

name: speech emotion recognition Hindi (Kaggle vishlb)
source_rights_note: The Kaggle field licenses the database under ODbL and says the contents belong to 'Original Authors', who are not named; where the recordings come from and whether the speakers consented are unknown. The uploader has not been contacted yet. Needs a rights check (needs-confirmation list); license_class keeps the stated license.

name: KBES
source_rights_note: Paper (Ethics Statements): dialogs taken from public telefilms, dramas and web series on YouTube and Facebook; the authors say YouTube videos are usable for derivative works and that there are no copyright issues. The paper lists no sources, per-video licenses or performer consent, and has no non-commercial statement. CC BY 4.0 covers the authors' clipping and annotation. Needs a rights check (needs-confirmation list); license_class keeps the stated license.

name: M3ED
source_rights_note: Clips of 56 TV series (about 500 episodes). The GitHub repository states no license; the sources read say nothing about rights in the series. Needs a rights check; license_class keeps the stated license (none).

name: Maleo Emotion
source_rights_note: The clips are cut from YouTube videos. The data card states CC BY 4.0 but says nothing about the rights in the videos, and there is no paper. Needs a rights check (needs-confirmation list); license_class keeps the stated license.

name: MC-EIU
source_rights_note: Clips from 3 English and 4 Chinese TV series. The data license is CC BY-NC 4.0 (gated on Hugging Face); the rights in the series themselves were not found in the sources read. Needs a rights check; license_class keeps the stated license.

name: MDER-MA
source_rights_note: The clips are cut from Moroccan reality shows, radio, podcasts and interviews. The paper (Ethics Statement) says the data come from public sources, that the websites' terms of service were followed and that no consent was required; it names no sources and has no non-commercial statement. Needs a rights check (needs-confirmation list); license_class keeps the stated license.

name: MER2023
source_rights_note: Video clips from films and TV series. The challenge EULA restricts use; nothing read about the rights in the source material. Needs a rights check; license_class keeps the stated license.

name: PEMO
source_rights_note: Utterances are extracted from Punjabi films and web series; the summary read states no license or rights (the paper was not read). Needs a rights check (needs-confirmation list); license_class keeps the stated license.

name: ShEMO
source_rights_note: Radio-play excerpts. The README offers the data free for academic purposes (taken as the license by the maintainer's decision) and says nothing about the rights in the radio material. Needs a rights check (needs-confirmation list); license_class keeps the stated license.

name: Thanushs25 tamil
source_rights_note: The card states neither license nor origin. By ear (the maintainer) the clips are film or television audio, so the rights would belong to others; the origin itself is unconfirmed. The uploader has not been contacted yet. Needs a rights check (needs-confirmation list); license_class keeps the stated license.

name: URDU
source_rights_note: The clips come from YouTube Urdu talk shows. The README says only that anyone may use the data for research purposes; neither it nor the paper mentions the rights in the videos or permission from the programmes. Needs a rights check (needs-confirmation list); license_class keeps the stated license.

name: UrduSER
source_rights_note: Ethics Statement (as quoted in the project review): the clips were selected because they were explicitly licensed under Creative Commons or were short excerpts consistent with fair use for research and academic purposes; only the extracted audio is distributed. It does not say which clips are which, nor which Creative Commons license applies. Fair use does not permit commercial use, so non-commercial clips may be mixed in. The maintainer proceeds with the displayed CC BY 4.0 and will check later. Needs a rights check (needs-confirmation list); license_class keeps the stated license.

name: ViSEC
source_rights_note: The paper's abstract says the audio was collected from public media. The re-publication (CC BY 4.0) says nothing about the rights in that material, and the original repository cannot be read. Needs a rights check (needs-confirmation list); license_class keeps the stated license.

name: Cantonese Emotional Speech (hon9kon9ize)
source_rights_note: Audio crawled from YouTube and RTHK; the card states no license and says nothing about the rights in the source material. Needs a rights check; license_class keeps the stated license (none).
